lines.text: Astra: films with subtitle fonts attached (most anime) no longer download all the fonts before the first picture.
On a slow connection that was 10 seconds or more of waiting. The fonts now load beside the film.
Working out what is inside a file has a time limit, so an odd file cannot hold a film for a minute and a half.
When this phone cannot play a film at all, Astra says so in a plain sentence.
